# @haruhimemoe/osu

> osu! API v2 for TypeScript, in six entry points. `@haruhimemoe/osu/shapes` is browser-safe: zod schemas and types for a difficulty (`BeatmapMeta` and osu!'s `/api/v2/beatmaps` row), a beatmapset's content fields (`OsuBeatmapsetExtended`), and the signed-in user (`toOsuUser`), plus osu! page and cover URLs and the sign-in endpoints. `@haruhimemoe/osu/collections` is browser-safe and loads no zod: `readCollectionDb` and `writeCollectionDb` for osu!stable's `collection.db` (Uint8Array in and out, byte-for-byte round trips, a `CollectionDbError` with a `code` and byte offset), plus `addToCollection`, `mergeCollections`, `collectionHashesFor` and `lazerImportFiles` for adding maps to collections in stable, or in lazer through its setup-wizard import. `@haruhimemoe/osu/format` is browser-safe and imports nothing: display text for length (`m:ss`), star rating, BPM, CS/AR/OD/HP, file sizes and ranges. `@haruhimemoe/osu/match` is browser-safe: game status (aborted, in progress), per-game winners (team vs or head-to-head, by score, accuracy or combo) and map wins with warmups skipped, and `matchCosts` (Bathbot, osu!plus, Flashlight or Elitebotix formula), over an `OsuMatch`. `@haruhimemoe/osu/tournament` is browser-safe: `buildLazerBracket` writes the osu!lazer tournament client's `bracket.json` from plain teams, rounds and matches. `@haruhimemoe/osu` re-exports all of them and adds `createOsuClient` for servers: a cached client-credentials token, a required User-Agent, per-request timeouts, a `beforeCall` hook for a shared rate budget, and `getBeatmaps`, `getBeatmapsets`, `getStarRating`, `getUser` (by id or username, null on 404), `getUsers` (by ids, 50 a call) and `getMatch` (a multiplayer match by id or mp link, every event paged in with `before`, as `{ match, complete }`). Every failure talking to osu! is an `OsuApiError` with a `code`. ESM only, Node 22.12 or later, TypeScript 5.7 or later for the root and `/collections` types (or `skipLibCheck`), zod ^4.0.16 as a peer dependency, MIT.

Keep `createOsuClient` on a server: it holds the OAuth client secret. Browser code imports only `@haruhimemoe/osu/shapes`, `/collections`, `/format`, `/match` and `/tournament`.

## Docs

- [Install](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#install): npm or bun, with zod as a peer dependency.
- [The client](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#the-client): one client per process, and how the token is cached and refreshed.
- [Options](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#options): `userAgent`, `credentials`, `baseUrl`, `timeoutMs`, `fetch` and `now`, with defaults and the errors bad values throw.
- [Methods](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#methods): `getBeatmaps`, `getBeatmapsets`, `getStarRating`, `getBeatmap`, `getUser`, `getUsers`, `getUserProfile`, `getUserScores`, `getBeatmapUserScores`, `getBeatmapScores` and `getMatch`, and exactly which ids land in each result list.
- [Errors](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#errors): `OsuApiError`'s `code`, `status`, `retryAfterMs` and `cause`.
- [Staying under osu!'s rate limit](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#staying-under-osus-rate-limit): a `beforeCall` budget shared by every instance.
- [Client exports](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#client-exports): the root entry point's exports.
- [Shapes](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#shapes): the `/shapes` exports and every `BeatmapMeta` field.
- [Collections](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#collections): what `collection.db` holds, a read, add and write example for stable and lazer, and the steps users follow to put the result back.
- [Collection functions](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#functions): each function's options, rules and errors, including the reader's `maxBytes / 34` entry cap and its first 1,000 warnings.
- [Collection errors and warnings](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#errors-and-warnings): `CollectionDbError` codes and the reader's warnings.
- [Format](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#format): each `/format` function and the text it returns.
- [Match](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#match): `gameStatus`, `listGames`, `gameWinner`, `mapWins`, `matchCosts` and its four formulas, and how aborts, warmups and team totals are judged.
- [Tournament](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#tournament): `buildLazerBracket` and the input to `bracket.json` field mapping.
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu#compatibility): Node, Bun, browsers, zod, the TypeScript lib and `moduleResolution` settings, and TypeScript 5.7 for the root entry.

## Source

- [src/client/client.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/client/client.ts): `createOsuClient`, with JSDoc on each method. [users.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/client/users.ts) has `getUser` and `getUsers`, [matches.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/client/matches.ts) has `getMatch`, [scores.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/client/scores.ts) has the profile and score lookups and `getBeatmap`, [errors.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/client/errors.ts) has `OsuApiError`, and [types.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/client/types.ts) the option and result types.
- [src/shapes/beatmap.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/shapes/beatmap.ts): rulesets, `BeatmapMeta`, osu!'s beatmap row and `toBeatmapMeta`.
- [src/shapes/beatmapset.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/shapes/beatmapset.ts): beatmapset content fields and `isExtendedBeatmapset`.
- [src/shapes/user.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/shapes/user.ts): the `/api/v2/me` schema and `toOsuUser`, and the profile with statistics. [src/shapes/score.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/shapes/score.ts): the lazer score row and `toOsuScore`.
- [src/shapes/match.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/shapes/match.ts): the `/api/v2/matches/{id}` schemas, `OsuMatch`, `toOsuMatch` and `parseMatchId`.
- [src/match/index.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/match/index.ts): the `/match` helpers.
- [src/tournament/index.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/tournament/index.ts): `buildLazerBracket`.
- [src/shapes/links.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/shapes/links.ts): `OSU_BASE_URL`, `OSU_OAUTH`, `OSU_SIGN_IN_SCOPES`, `coverUrl`, `beatmapUrl`, `beatmapsetUrl`, `userUrl`.
- [src/collections/read.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/collections/read.ts): `readCollectionDb` and its warning codes.
- [src/collections/write.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/collections/write.ts): `writeCollectionDb`.
- [src/collections/edit.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/collections/edit.ts): `createCollectionDb`, `normalizeHash`, `collectionHashesFor`, `addToCollection`, `mergeCollections`, `lazerImportFiles`.
- [src/format/index.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/format/index.ts): the `/format` functions.
- [src/collections/model.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/collections/model.ts) and [errors.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu/blob/main/src/collections/errors.ts): `CollectionDb`, the limits, and `CollectionDbError`.

## Package

- [npm: @haruhimemoe/osu](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/osu): published versions.

## Related

- [osu! API v2 documentation](https://osu.ppy.sh/docs/): endpoints, scopes and the terms of use (at most 60 requests a minute).
- [@haruhimemoe/compliance](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/compliance): judges an extended beatmapset with `factsFromOsuBeatmapset`.
- [@haruhimemoe/hinai](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/hinai): a client for the hinai beatmap mirror that returns `BeatmapMeta` from these shapes.
- [haruhime.moe](https://www.haruhime.moe): the osu! tools this package is built for.
- [packs](https://packs.haruhime.moe): osu! beatmap packs for tournament hosts. Uses this package.
- [pools](https://pools.haruhime.moe): osu! mappools for tournament hosts, in beta. Uses this package.
